meta.note: A list for people and for a later config-driven setup. No game file reads these files today. Nothing here changes what the game does.
meta.shape_note: "fields" is the list of the request. "screens" is a second list (tabs, bars, pages, flows, menu rows, and two math functions) so that used_by, depends_on and feeds_into can point at a screen by id.
meta.why_note: why is the text of an "i" button, or the line "why the game asks" that is shown with a question. A plain help line under a question is in help, and why stays null.
meta.io_note: io is "asks" (the player gives something) or "shows" (the game shows something).
meta.coverage_note: Written by hand from the code: the opening, the rest of setup, Home, My Money, Next Steps, Me, the account, the admin page, the coach page, add-ons. Found by scans and marked confidence "low": questions drawn with q(), kitAsk(), typed inputs, stat tiles, and the question lists LIFE, KN_ASK, STG_FACTS, HH_QUESTIONS, ASK, AK_*. Not covered: chips and buttons drawn by other code in about 100 feature files (see AUDIT.md, "What this audit did not cover").
meta.addon_note: The two add-ons are sealed files. They are named here only as addon:x1 and addon:x2 (the names of the files game/x1.json and game/x2.json). Their fields cannot be listed from this repository.
